theme: Hospital Death (Clinical Procedures and medical management) related deaths

reports.title: Iris Grimwood
categories: Hospital Death (Clinical Procedures and medical management) related deaths

concerns.quote: difficulties in providing the level of nursing care that Iris needed

mistakes were made in the use of semi-automatic thermometers for measuring body temperature and an episode was described where a nurse attempted to apply an antifungal ointment to Iris's genital region
less than optimal numbers of nursing staff, compounded by difficulties in recruitment and retention of nursing staff as well as problems with funding training

reports.title: Elaine Bradbrook
categories: Hospital Death (Clinical Procedures and medical management) related deaths

promises.quote: The Trust recognises that the SI process at that time was poor. However we have, in the last 12 months, made significant improvements to our SI process and this incorporates training across the Trust on undertaking SI investigations. This process is being overseen by me and the Director of Nursing and we currently have in post an Interim Director of Governance who is leading on this project. Our new Risk Manager also commenced in post in February 2018.
promises.summary: Improved SI process with training and new governance roles

concerns.quote: There was a failure to escalate and act on Elaine's deteriorating condition from at least 14.00 on 22 April 2017, when her NEWS was 6, and her GCS is also likely to have dropped.
concerns.hazard: failure to escalate and act on deteriorating condition

concerns.quote: There was a failure to record a single GCS after 14.00, when her level of consciousness dropped. I found no evidence of any clinical or nursing review after this time.
concerns.hazard: failure to record GCS and conduct clinical review

concerns.quote: There was a failure to discuss Elaine's condition with neurosurgeons in Nottingham again before she was transferred to Nottingham, when it was clear that her condition had deteriorated significantly.
concerns.hazard: failure to discuss condition with neurosurgeons before transfer

concerns.quote: There was a failure to reduce the risks during transfer - a patient with a GCS of 4 and a history of vomiting was handed over to ambulance staff with an unprotected airway and without clinical review, or escort.

The trust appears not to have appreciated the significance of these issues. It has not carried out any internal investigation, nor contacted Elaine's family in line with its duty of candour. I am concerned that there has been no opportunity for learning within the trust, following these serious failures.
concerns.hazard: lack of internal investigation and family contact

concerns.quote: The trust's procedure for carrying out High Level Investigations and Serious Untoward Incident Investigations should be reviewed.
